notes.title: Simbro ResErection News (2025-04-15)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm here with some more news about SimbroResErection development. Let's dive in!

So, what's taking so long? I'm glad you asked. The game has had a lot of ongoing bugs and bottlenecks which I've been trying to address. Initially, the goal for this update was to add climax scenes and expand upon the sex scenes by making a free mode, dialogue mode, and a "skill" mode. As I've been incorporating these things I realized the current dialogue engine wasn't going to cut it for the dialogue mode. This has led me into a rabbit hole of optimization. I've been refactoring code to use structs and arrays while replacing the dialogue engine to make the initial update goal plausible and the game as stable as possible. So let's get into the specifics.

[u][b]New Dialogue System[/b][/u]
The new dialogue system was a big undertaking. It has a new text renderer which supports proper text tags, and text effects, and supports LTR languages. The new engine lets you use numbers on the keyboard to select choices, can change character emotes and animations, and has skill checks integrated so dialogues can now branch based on a character's skills.

[u][b]New Translation System[/b][/u]
The old translation system was not great. It used broken json files to store multiple languages which made adding a language confusing and a massive chore. The new translation system sets out to fix that. First, all dialogue is now stored in easy-to-read txt files. Second, all languages have their own folder for organizations. Third, adding a new translation is much simpler. All you need to do is copy the English folder, rename it to your language, and start translating the files inside. When you start up the game it will automatically detect the folders and files and will add the folder names to the language selection in the settings menu.

[u][b]Dialogue Rewrites[/b][/u]
I have mentioned in previous posts that all of the dialogue needed to be rewritten. Well, with the new Dialogue and Translation System now was as good of a time as ever. Due to the new systems, I'm not able to just copy and paste dialogues from the old system. The old dialogue also didn't support skill checks, emote and animation changes etc. So, I've been going through all of the dialogue in the game and reworking/rewriting. Now, girls in the slums can be bargained with (charm check) and the lost girl event has multiple options to avoid fights if your reputation is low. You'll be able to bribe or bargain with debt collectors and you'll find some alternate dialogue for some events.

[u][b]Scene Transitions and Texture Management[/b][/u]
As the game has grown so has the need for texture management. I won't go too in-depth with this but essentially, large textures are loaded and unloaded when needed which saves memory and makes the game run faster and more compatible with devices with lower memory. All of this is done whenever there is a transition in-game (fade to black). The new transition system is responsible for making this as smooth as possible. The new transition system also has new effects for scene transitions which makes things look a little nicer.

[u][b]Saving and Loading[/b][/u]
While working on refactoring code to switch from data structures to structs and arrays, I've also changed how things are saved and loaded. This now makes saving and loading much easier (on my end). I've also added more save slots to the game and an auto-save feature. You'll now have 10 "pages" for saves (1 for auto-saves and 9 for regular saves) and your game will save at the end of each day.

[u][b]Combat VFX[/b][/u]
In the midst of all of this, I've also added VFX to some of the attacks in the combat system. Attacks like Charm and Defend now have visual queues which make the success of these moves more evident. This is still a work in progress but I think it was needed to make the combat more "readable".

[u][b]Sex Animation[/b][/u]
I've been slowly plugging away at adding all the new transition animations for climax scenes into the game. For context, each ses position in the game needs 3 "transition" animations. One to start the climax, one to end the climax, and one for idle animation after everything is done. This means over 30 new "transition" animations are needed to make all of the scenes feel "natural".

[u][b]What am I working on now?[/b][/u]
Currently, I'm still working on the animations for the game and the dialogue rewrites and implementation. Once those two things are done I'll be fully implementing the new sex scene modes and testing the game. I can't say when all this will be finished but I promise that I'm working hard to get this update out.

[u][b]Conclusion[/b][/u]
As you can imagine all of this has been/is a lot of work. I mentioned before that I don't want history to repeat itself by having a bug-ridden game that gets slowly dropped due to broken systems. All of this work is to make the game as stable as possible to make future updates easier. My goal has always been and always will be to complete this game and make it as enjoyable as possible. This upcoming update will ensure the game runs at its best and provides me with the tools to make better content.

notes.title: Simbro ResErection News (2025-02-07)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! After a very stressful January, I'm back with some news. January was not a good start to the year for me. To keep it short, a family member received bad news from their doctor which has made working on the game difficult. I won't go into any more details here but if you'd like to know more you can contact me on Discord for a better explanation. I'm happy to let you know what's going.

On to the news! The most recent release of the game has exposed some concerning bottlenecks in its code. I've received more reports of silent game crashes, and I'm working on removing these bottlenecks. These changes will likely increase transition times when moving from one location to another but should improve the game's stability.

Due to the IRL events I've decided to take the development direction of the game in to my own hands. This means that polls (for Patreon and Subscribe Star) will only consist of what art assets get worked on next. Speaking of art assets, SkullZombie has been working on pregnancy art for the game! Once all of the outfits are adapted I'll be adding Pregnancy (Optional) to the game. What's coming in the next update? I'm glad you asked! I'll be adding Climax scenes to the game. I'll also be working on the sex scene mechanics for the game. As it is right now, sex scenes don't do anything aside from playing animations. This next update will fix that by adding three different "modes" to the game. The first mode will be "Free mode". This will allow you to view sexs scenes without losing stamina or gaining stats. The second mode will be "Game mode" and will be the default. "Game mode" will introduce climax bars to the game. These bars will fill up according to the character's stats. Once the bar fills up the corresponding character will climax and experience points will be rewarded based on character level. The last mode will be "Dialogue mode". This mode will be used for scenes in the game (like the Eva recruitment scene). "Dialogue mode" will not use Climax bars. Instead, scenes that use this mode will have branching dialogue that considers the character's stats.

In addition to the above, I'll also be working on adding more save slots to the game along with some other smaller QOL improvements. My main objective right now is to make the game as stable as possible before moving on (wouldn't want history to repeat itself).I'd like to take this time to thank everyone for their kind words of support. I'm still devoted to working on the game regardless of my IRL situation and your continued support makes working on the game a nice reprieve from reality. I can't wait to improve the game and add more tools for storytelling. Happy belated New Year and thanks again from the bottom of my heart.

notes.title: Simbro ResErection News (2024-09-16)
notes.content:
Finally! I'm back with news for Simbro ResErection! Let's take some time to go over what's new and what's next to come.

So, this update took a lot longer than expected. As mentioned before this was due to improving the game's performance and trying to fix/limit the number of silent crashes. In the end, I've doubled the performance on all platforms aside from Mac (Mac should still see some performance enhancements). This isn't without trade-offs. Due to the way the game is compiled, players will no longer receive error messages. This will likely result in a silent crash but I believe the performance enhancements are worth it.

[u][b]When will we get the update?[/b][/u]

As usual, other subscription-based platforms get updates 1 week earlier. So this update will be out in 7 days. This allows me to receive bug reports and apply patches before post it here.

[u][b]What was causing the silent crashes?[/b][/u]

I narrowed the silent crashes down to how the game was compiled and texture swaps. I've solved the compile issue and fixed some texture swap issues. The texture swap issues are a little more complicated to fix. Basically, when a character icon is made (contacts menu, stage plan, shop items, etc.) it creates a new texture sheet. the game needs to swap between these texture sheets to draw the icons on screen. This can cause older (or less powerful) computers to freeze up and close the game.

[u][b]What's the fix?[/b][/u]

To permanently fix the issue I would need to create assets for everything an icon contains. This means every hairstyle, face shape, clothing item, etc. would need its own unique asset for each type of icon in the game. As you can imagine, this is a lot of work and only adds to the workload whenever a new character customization option is added. This will be something I tackle in the future, but for now, I hope the previous fix will suffice.

[u][b]What's in the Update!!![/b][/u]

I've already mentioned that the game now has multiple weapons and traits added along with unique attacks for every Class. I've spent a ton of time play-testing the game to ensure everything works as intended but I'll be surprised if I didn't eliminate all the bugs.

Combat has seen a massive overhaul with the introduction of buffs and debuffs. In my opinion, this has made the game a lot more enjoyable. I'll admit that spec-ing the characters a certain way can break the combat and make you essentially invincible, but I think that is also what makes it fun. I'll go over the attacks and status effects below.

[u][b]Attacks[/b][/u]

[i][b]Heal[/b][/i] - Heals and removes debuffs (Nurse, Doctor, Assistant)

[i][b]Cheer[/b][/i] - Buffs target increasing their damage and accuracy (Receptionist)

[i][b]Charm[/b][/i] - Inflicts Charm Debuff (Gigolo, Whore) (More details below)

[i][b]Intoxicate[/b][/i] - Inflicts Intoxicated Debuff (Bartender) (More details below)

[i][b]Protect[/b][/i] - Redirects attacks from target to user (Guard) (More details below)

[i][b]Back Stab[/b][/i] - An attack that ignores the defence status and always hits (Guaranteed Crit if the target isn't defending) (Butler, Maid)

[i][b]Grab[/b][/i] - Restrains target forcing them to either struggle or stomp (More details below)

[u][b]Grab Mechanics[/b][/u]

So, we finally have some grab mechanics in the game. Unfortunately, I couldn't add animations or options for stripping or nasty things yet (due to the current model setup) but it does function for combat purposes. Characters that are being held now have two options, struggle, or stomp. Stomp has a chance to deal 1-3 damage to the assailant. If a character Struggles they will try to break free of the grab. If the character being held is charmed or intoxicated they will skip their turn. Characters currently holding another character can either Wait or Release the held character. Physical attacks on held characters always hit.

Currently, poorly drawn icons are the only indicators for character grabbing or being held. Once the main model is updated to handle multiple characters of the same gender I'll have Thelawfulsock do proper animations.

[u][b]Weapon Types[/b][/u]

[i][b]Blunt[/b][/i] - Blunt weapons have a chance to stun characters that are not defending (more below)

[i][b]Pierce[/b][/i] - Pierce weapons have a chance to act as a Back Stab attack (ignoring defence status or dealing a crit)

[i][b]Slash[/b][/i] - Slash weapons have a chance to inflict Bleeding on characters that are not defending (more below)

All weapon types have a 5% chance of activating their effect. Weapons have different damage, hit rate, and crit chance. You can see the weapons stats in the shop or inventory screen.

[u][b]Status Effects[/b][/u]

[i][b]Stun[/b][/i] - Prevents character from acting for two turns. If a stun character is hit they will no longer be stunned.

[i][b]Bleed[/b][/i] - Characters will receive damage (1/10 of current health) at the beginning of their turn for two turns

[i][b]Charmed[/b][/i] - Charmed characters will act as allies for two turns. If a charmed character is hit they will no longer be charmed.

[i][b]Intoxicated[/b][/i] - Characters will act randomly attacking friends and foes for two turns.

[b][i]Protection[/i][/b] - Redirects attacks. If the redirect target gets stunned, charmed, intoxicated or grabbed the protection gets removed

I think that wraps up everything for combat. Like I said, I tried testing every scenario and buff debuff combo but I'm sure I missed something.

[u][b]Let's talk about Weapons![/b][/u]

In this update, you can purchase weapons from the Shop. This is temporary until a weapon/armour shop is added to the game. Once the shop is added most weapons will be locked behind mission progression related to the shop owner. Also, the weapons stats will be adjusted as more feedback comes in.

[u][b]Where is the polish?[/b][/u]

You will notice that some attacks and status effects have no animation. My main aim was to get everything functioning and this update out. I know everyone has been patiently waiting and I'm sure everyone would rather I spend the time adding content they want. As things progress, I plan to polish these things on the side.

[u][b]Where do we go from here?[/b][/u]

With this last update out we are finally on to the second stage of development. This stage will consist of updates that add content and make the game more... game-like. Currently, things like living caps, runaway customers, tired brothel employees, and reputation gain, among other things haven't been added to make the game somewhat "enjoyable". In the coming months, I plan to fix these things while also holding polls (On other platforms) on what I work towards next.

[u][b]Outro[/b][/u]

As always I'd like to take some time to thank all of you for supporting the game. I can't thank everyone enough for giving me this opportunity. I love interacting with everyone and I look forward to hearing your new ideas and feedback every day. Thank you for keeping this dream going and being the pillars to this great community.

notes.title: Simbro ResErection News (2024-06-24)
notes.content:
Wow! Time really flew by this last month. I'm back with some news from the field and some insight into the development of the game.

[u][b]Combat Update Progress[/b][/u]
So, first things first. I'm hard at work on the combat update. As you can imagine, updating the combat system for the game is no small task. I've been constantly adding new things to the combat system, testing, adjusting, and tasting again. It's been an enriching experience, to say the least.

Right now, I have reworked a large chunk of the combat system. Currently, I've added things like critical hits, hit chance, healing, defending, and a rework to the turn order system. With all of these changes, there has been a lot of balancing needed along with advancements to enemy AI. I've also been working on how enemies spawn (The number of enemies and their levels) and adjusting how they pick their stats according to their class. As of writing this everything is working as expected, but it's only the tip of the iceberg. I still need to add all the special attacks for each class, new traits for combat, animations, and the ability to purchase weapons.

When can you expect the next update? Well, as mentioned before, this combat update will need to be split into two updates due to how much is being added to the game. With that in mind, I do hope to have an update out next month.

[u][b]Upcoming Development Cycle[/b][/u]
With the last of the major systems being added to the game, Simbro ResErection will be starting a new development cycle! This means that how we work on the game and what content will be added will be drastically different from how we first started out. The main focus during this period is to get the game in a playable state while also adding content that will make each update more exciting. This means that in each update I will be working on things in the game like reputation gain, Gloryhole mechanics, security room mechanics, client actions (like leaving without paying), etc. With that said, I will be holding a poll each month for our Subscribers to vote on to determine what content will be added to the game while these things get worked on.

[u][b]What's coming?[/b][/u]
As you're reading this, SkullZombie is currently working on more weapons for the game. After sitting down and looking at what the original game had for weapons I realized that the original didn't have enough variety to make the combat exciting. So, I came up will a small list of weapons for SkullZombie to draw in order to give you more choices when it comes to weaponry.

On the topic of new weapons, I will also be trying out a new system for weapons. The plan is to add damage types to weapons. These types will be Blunt, Slashing, and Piercing damage. What will damage types do you ask? Well, to put it simply, each damage type will have a chance to inflict a status effect or ignore buffs. I can't say too much yet, but you could imagine blunt weapons stunning an enemy, or slashing weapons causing a bleeding effect. I also hope that this will allow for more diversity in combat.

On to Mamacita (Our amazing background artist). Mamacita is working on backgrounds for all of the rooms currently available in the game. These are the Master Bedroom, maid's Room, Security Room, Staff Room, and Dorm Room. Unlike the original, I want to utilize every room in the game for possible events, scenarios, and other things. I look forward to seeing what Mamacita comes up with.

[u][b]Why haven't you added X to the game yet?[/b][/u]
Now, I wanted to take some time to address some questions about why I haven't added certain features to the game. A lot of fans have asked about why certain things haven't been added and when or if we plan to add them. To give you a brief summary, most of these things are due to either the amount of time it takes to implement or technical limitations. I'll go over as many as possible below.

[u][b]Why haven't you added female-on-female action in the game?[/b][/u]
There are two main reasons for this not being implemented yet. The first has to do with how animations are done and the game. The second has to do with the content itself.

Right now, Simbro ResErection relies on Spine animation. Spine is a software that allows users to assign bones to an image so they can manipulate it like you would a 3D model. Essentially you move the bones (which move an image) and record those actions to make an animation. This requires us to have models (or dolls) for each character we have in a scene. Currently, we have 1 male model and 1 female model in the animation file for the game. Each model has a set of skins that we can swap between to allow us to give the character a different look. Things like hairstyle and clothes are all skins we can apply to the model.

A problem arises when it comes to adding a second female model. First, this means that any new changes to one female model needs to be replicated, essentially doubling the workload whenever we add new skins. The second comes when we consider upgrading the models.

As you can see, this would add a lot of extra work when it comes to adjusting the models in any way. This extra work would prolong the release of updates whenever we add a new skin to the female model or adjust how the female model works. At this point in time, I can't afford to prolong the updates or hire a dedicated animator. Which is the main reason why this has been avoided.

Let's talk about the content itself. I've heard plenty of people state that the whole reason anybody plays the game is for the female-on-female actions. This isn't something I can dispute, but it also is not something that I can't blindly agree with. I understand that plenty of people enjoy this content. I also understand that even if the majority agrees, we can't alienate the minority. For this reason, I've always planned to make female-on-female action a togglable option. We need to consider that things we might enjoy might not bring the same enjoyment to others.

[u][b]So when do I plan to add female-on-female action?[/b][/u]
Now that we've talked about the reasoning behind not adding female-on-female content I'd like to acknowledge that there will come a time when we need to add this feature regardless of workload. Currently, the folks over at Game Maker are working on implementing a new version of Spine compatibility. This new compatibility will allow the models to utilize the physics engine. This means that things like hair animation (among other things) will be removed from the workflow once we upgrade the models. My plan is to wait for that integration before making female-on-female content available as an option in upcoming polls.

[u][b]When will you add X skin colour/ Will we be able to change hairstyle colour?[/b][/u]
Another question that is asked a lot is about changing the colour of assets in-game. So let's dive into how assets are made and what's involved when it comes to changing the colour of assets.

So, to start, each asset (Hair, Skin, Clothes, etc.) is typically made with a colour in mind. When we create a new asset in the game, we use references from the original Simbro to try and keep the aesthetic of the original game as close as possible. This has led to what we have today (Assets with a single colour).

When changing the colour of an asset we have two options. The first is to make a separate asset that is a different colour. The second is to use the game engine to "colourize" (Add a colour on top to change its appearance) the assets. The current skin tone options are a good example of "colourizing" assets. Each body part has a colour added to darken the skin tone to give it a new appearance.

Each solution has its own difficulties. First, adding another asset to the game for each possible colour variant creates a ton more texture pages. This isn't ideal due to Texture Page Swapping. I won't go into too much detail, but essential, the more texture pages we add, the slower the game gets. We want to avoid this because it can the game more demanding to run and may even prevent lower-spec systems from running the game.

The second solution (colorization), also has its flaws. When we add a colour on top of an existing asset, we "tint" the entire image. This means that we can really only make the image darker and we also need to "tint" the highlights of the image which isn't ideal. A half solution is to create all the assets in a sort of greyscale. This would allow us to "tint" the image to almost any colour but also means that things like highlights would be almost non-existent.

Honestly, I'm still working on how to best approach this. However, I believe that adding assets for each colour isn't a viable option. I also don't like the idea of sacrificing art quality just to add more options to the game. Ideally, I would like to separate the highlights from each asset and draw them on top, but the amount of work required to do so is astronomical.

[u][b]When do you plan to add colour options for these assets?[/b][/u]
I can't give a time frame for when this is added. It is something that I want to add in the future but is at the bottom of the priority list. I do plan to have skin tone options out for the male characters as a first step toward this goal, but again, can't give a date.

[u][b]Will we have an option to change body types for Male and Female characters?[/b][/u]
Another popular question. The short answer is yes. We do plan to add some sort of option to change body types. However, it's a ton of work and not viable for a while.

Let's talk about what is involved in making a new body type. First, we need to make a new base model for the body type. This is probably the easiest as SkullZombie has a ton of experience with both drawing and Spine. The second is creating a new model in Spine. Again, this isn't too complicated. Our go-to animator Thelawfulsock is an expert in this field. The problems arise when it comes to animations and customization options. Each new body type means we need to make every animation in the game over again. Anything from combat animations to idle animations needs to be replicated for the new body type. We also need to add all available customization options as well. This means redrawing all clothes and sometimes hairstyles and facial features too.

With all that work comes expenses. Right now I'm (TheGentleViking) the only full-time worker on this project. All of our other team members are freelancers who need to make a living doing paid work. So right now, we don't have the resources needed to put this out in a timely manner without postponing other content releases.

[u][b]When do you plan to include new body types?[/b][/u]
Again, I can't give any sort of time frame or date. What I can say is that it is being worked on when we have resources available.

notes.title: v0.07 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We have a new version of Simbro ResErection for you! Let's dive in.

First, I want to talk about Classes. So, we have come up with some classes that work for both Male and Female MCs. Some of these classes have different names but are going to function the same. While doing the classes we decided to make each class follow a "classic" RPG. What we mean is we wanted to make a Tank, Attacker, Healer, etc. We figured this would be the best way to try and assign roles to each class in combat.

One thing to note is that we haven't added the unique attacks to the combat system. This is due to our upcoming rework of the combat system. We didn't want to rework the current system only to do that work over when the Combat Update happens. We do have unique attacks ready, it's just not implemented.

Next, let's talk about traits. So, in this update, we include a good amount of brothel-based traits. Each trait was designed to have a "counterpart" trait that does the opposite. We also tried making every trait have a positive and negative effect. We wanted to take people's focus off of obtaining the "best" trait and have everyone focus on how they are going to use traits. Right now, the majority of the traits are fully functional. With that said, their are some traits that deal with clients leaving without paying that doesn't work yet. We hope to add this to the game soon.

So, what about non-brothel-based traits? Well, we've decided that we will add those traits alongside updates that are more related to those traits. This means that once we do the Combat Update, we plan to add a bunch of traits that focus on combat. Once we add the next floor that allows you to build bars and VIP rooms, we will add traits that relate to those as well. This also goes for gained traits.

On the topic of traits. We are currently working on a way for characters to gain more traits. Right now we plan to have characters gain "trait points" every 5 or 10 levels. This will allow you to spend trait points to gain new traits! This is still a work in progress, but we hope it's something that adds to the game.

Last but not least is compatibility with old saves. So, those who would like to continue an old save but don't want to miss out on giving their MC a trait don't need to worry. We added a way for you to pick a trait for any character that doesn't already have one. Just open the stat screen and you should notice a button by the traits category. Unfortunately, we weren't able to do this with Classes, yet. Due to how classes work and how we assign class stats, we will need a little longer to implement a way to change your MCs Class on older saves. notes.title: Next Update & News (2024-01-23)
notes.content:
Hey, Everyone! We've got some info on the next update along with a release date and some general news.

[u][b]Next Update Info[/b][/u]
Now to talk about the Class & Traits Update. This update is pretty straightforward. We will be adding base classes to the character creation screen. Each class will have base stats and one or two unique attacks. On top of that, we will also be incorporating the new traits system. The new traits system will give characters unique bonuses for different jobs. Some characters might have traits that make them suitable for combat, while others might be considered lovers and not fighters. We hope this gives each character a unique "feel" regarding how you manage them.

[u][b]Events & Gameplay Part 2 Release[/b][/u]
I've been hard at work getting part 2 done for the (Steam) release on the 6th of next month (9:00 pm EST). The reason the shop was put into part two is because of how I designed it. Unlike the original, the shop will not be text-based. Instead, we've opted for a more visual approach. This will make translation much easier and also allow you to see the items you're buying while you browse the shop. The idea is to use this design in the character creation, Inventory, Plastic Surgery, and Character Editor.

Let's talk about changes. So, I've decided that clothes will no longer give stat boosts. This is something that I've been toying with since day one and I believe it will make the game less complicated and more enjoyable. I dislike the idea of choosing between aesthetics and stats.

Aside from the shop, we've also reworked the shower and staff room and made a ton of bug fixes. We are still working on some more minor bugs, but the amount of game-breaking bugs has reduced significantly.

[u][b]Why the 6th of next month?[/b][/u]
Technically, the update will be out on the 30th of this month. However, due to how we monetize the game outside of Steam, we always release Steam versions 1 week later. Although this hasn't been a problem until now, we wanted to let you know because this pushes the release for Steam users to next month.

[u][b]Animation News (Not Good)[/b][/u]
Last news update I talked about how we had found an animator to do hand-drawn animations for "those" scenes. Unfortunately, that individual has disappeared. We've messaged them on Discord and on the site we originally recruited them from and haven't received a reply. This wouldn't be too concerning, but they've now blocked us on Discord.

Although this news is disheartening, we won't let it deter us from finding another animator. So, moving forward we will focus on adding "those" scenes differently until we find someone. We know everyone has been asking for "those" scenes and we will try to add them sooner rather than later. Even if that means we will need to redo the work once we have proper animations.

[u][b]Outro[/b][/u]
That's about it! I want to thank everyone for the support, bug reports, and suggestions. We have one of the greatest communities and it's because we have people like you supporting us. We look forward to working on the Class and Traits Update.

notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR FROM THE GENTLE VIKING AND TEAM!
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone! It's been a wonderful year for me and the team and we want to thank every one of you for making it such an incredible year. I had an eventful. I've had family in the hospital, quit my job to focus on programming, and even started learning new things to improve myself and the things I make. I look forward to what 2024 has to offer and I can't wait to see what it brings.

So, I want to talk a little bit about my goals for the new year. First, I'd like to give everyone a bi-weekly update on the game development. Most of you know that these sorts of posts are seemingly at random. However, this year, I'd like to take the time to keep everyone properly informed on how things are progressing. This may take time but it will be something I'm actively working on.

The second goal for this year is to get a writer, translators, and animator (to do the stuff Thelawfulsock can't) on the team. We've been looking for many of these positions for a while with little luck. With that said, I believe that we will find the right individuals this year.

My last goal is to get the game's base systems and mechanics complete. You may have noticed that none of our updates have focused on the main story or character story (Looking at you Alice). This is due to our systems and mechanics not being fleshed out and complete. We want to ensure that when we add these stories, we won't need to revisit them to implement features or rework them. Once we have all of the mechanics and systems in place we will be able to focus on just adding content, and that's our main goal for 2024.

Before I end this post, I'd like to take some time to address some negativity. First, I'd like to make it clear that I'm not the original developer of the old SimBro game and have never been a part of the development of the old SimBro Game. Myself and my team have been taking flak for mistakes made by the developers of the old SimBro team. For the most part, we understand and are happy to clear things up if the misinformed person is civil. With that said, we will not tolerate people posting hateful and defaming comments about us or the game due to this misunderstanding. We are happy to receive constructive criticism about our games and how we develop them and encourage people to do so. Let's try to keep this community positive or at least civil for everyone's sake.

Finally, the end of the post. Like always, I want to take the time to thank everyone who has supported us throughout 2023. It doesn't matter if it was from monetary support, leaving a positive comment, sharing our posts, or simply playing our game. We want to thank you all for a wonderful year. On behalf of myself and the team, we wish you a very Happy New Year and we look forward to what this new year brings.

So, as many of you know, we are currently working on the first part of the Events & Gameplay Update. As mentioned before, this update will be done in parts due to its large size. We don't have an exact release date for the next update, but we can guarantee it will be out before the new year.

[u][b]What to Expect in Events & Gameplay Update Part 1[/b][/u]
We've been working hard on getting systems cleaned up and workflows refined. Part of this was making one unified model for the characters in-game. Previously, we were using 3 different "models" for the game—one for the females, one for the males, and one for the male and female scenes. In the upcoming update, we will be merging the models into one unified project. This will help with animations, clothes, and anything regarding the look and feel of models. notes.title: Simbro ResErection Update v0.04
notes.content:
We're back with a new update! Before we get started, please note that older saves will be buggy due to the amount of new stuff. We suggest starting a new game for a better experience. If you just want to see what's new, scroll to the bottom to check out the changelog. We'll have more news in the coming weeks about what everyone is working on and the next update so stay tuned.

We've been working hard on the brothel update these past weeks. The system has been completely revamped and remade to make the game more enjoyable and scalable. On top of that, we've been adding more options for the female characters' appearance. Most of this was pretty easy, but some of it required some animation tweaking. We added a bunch of QoL improvements and so much more.

So, this update wasn't as straightforward as I thought it was going to be. As soon as I started I realized that I had to update a lot more than just the Brothel System. Mainly it was how characters replenished mood and hygiene and how time advancement works. I've had to completely revamp how time passes to ensure that the receptionist could assign workers properly. On top of that, I needed to add functionality to the showers, staffroom, and maid room.

Time to talk about the Brothel system. We've made some drastic changes to how prices are decided and how clients and workers are satisfied. Unlike the original, this Brothel System tries to take everything into account. Things like client job, mood, hygiene, wealth, and requests all affect the price and worker satisfaction. Things like the number of requests the worker fulfills and the worker's mood and hygiene have an effect on the client's satisfaction. All of these things will hopefully make the game more diverse and enjoyable. We will still need to tweak things as time passes but that's to be expected.

Next is the receptionist system. As mentioned before, this update will allow you to assign a receptionist to handle assigning workers. You'll be able to tell the receptionist to prioritize different things when assigning clients to workers. Right now you'll have 3 options, Lowest level, Money, and Satisfaction. Lowest Level will prioritize assigning clients to workers with the lowest levels first. This will allow you to get lower-level characters levels up faster, allowing you to earn more money in the long run. Money will prioritize how much is made over anything else. This will typically assign high-level characters first. Satisfaction prioritizes the client's needs/requests. We plan to add more options in the future but this should do for now.

Finally, I want to talk about things that we will still need to add to the brothel system in future updates. First is traits. We've added (and removed) some traits. Currently, these traits do nothing due to the time constraint I've set for myself. However, we do have plans to make traits a big part of the game (more about that in a later update). Second, is refining client stats and jobs. Right now, clients have different jobs which affect their base stats. We want to refine the job names to better suit the setting of the game and also add more variety. Third, is room quality and themes. At this point, room quality isn't part of the satisfaction or price formula. Once we do the Stage Plan update we hope to remedy this. Last but not least is reputation gain and security. This update won't have clients running away and the reputation gain is simple. We do plan to fix this once we have more systems in place.


Everyone on the SBR Team has been putting their best effort into making this a game to be proud of. We see your enthusiasm and support and it motivates us. We have big plans and seeing them come to fruition is one of the best feelings ever. We can't wait to hear your feedback!

As always, thank you for your support, thank you for your patience, and thank you for all of your enthusiasm. All of the achievements and all of this success is all because of you. We are truly humbled to have such a great community.

notes.title: Simbro ResErection Next Update (2023-07-25)
notes.content:
Our next update is (drum roll)... THE BROTHEL UPDATE!!!

So, with our next update decided and in the works. I want to go over what you can expect in the next update and some of the mechanics.

As most of you know, this update will have a big focus on client and worker relations. It will also focus on the receptionist and her ability to assign work. What we didn't mention before is the update to worker Traits and other changes. So let's dive into it.

[h1][u][b]Worker and Client Relations[/b][/u][/h1]
Worker and Client relations will be more complex. This will largely depend on worker traits and the stats of both the clients and workers. Stats like hygiene and mood will play a bigger part in the price clients will pay and how happy the girls are with the clients. Clients with low moods and hygiene are more likely to be disliked by the workers. At the same time, workers with low hygiene and mood will fetch a lower price with clients. Traits will also play a role in worker likes and dislikes but more about that later.

[h1][u][b]Client generation and jobs[/b][/u][/h1]
One big rework or overhaul will be Client generation and jobs. Clients will now have unique appearances. Along with appearances, Clients will have unique jobs which will decide the range of their stats and the chance of trying to leave without paying. For example, Clients with a politician job will have better hygiene and wealth compared to a thug. Getting better Clients will rely on your reputation.

[h1][u][b]Client Requests[/b][/u][/h1]
Client requests will also be a feature added in the next update. These requests will be limited at first (Until we add more clothes, traits, and other things), but they will play a big part in client satisfaction.

[h1][u][b]Setting Prices and Bonuses[/b][/u][/h1]
Setting prices and bonuses was a big mechanic in the original. We want to try and rework this mechanic to make it clearer to the player how prices affect the clients and how bonuses affect the workers. The original had you set a price and sort of barter with the client. Setting the price too high would lower the client's mood and they would refuse your offer. We want to change this. Instead, we want to incorporate a satisfaction meter. This meter will be affected by the requests fulfilled, price set, and workers assigned to the client. Clients won't be able to refuse your offers, but dissatisfied customers will lower your reputation and may lead to other consequences. Likewise, we want to give the workers the same satisfaction meter. Their meter will be affected by the client's stats and bonus set. Keeping your workers satisfied will reduce mood and stamina loss.

[h1][u][b]Worker Traits[/b][/u][/h1]
Although traits are part of a bigger update, we feel it's best to include some traits that will affect the brothel's business. We've come up with 16 traits to include in the new update. These traits can affect the worker's stamina, client's satisfaction, experience gained, and worker's feelings towards clients. Some of these traits are better than others and will appear less frequently. We have plans to allow you to influence traits and even remove them, but that will be in a different update.

[h1][u][b]Receptionist[/b][/u][/h1]
Another big part of this update is the receptionist. In the original game, you needed to upgrade the brothel to assign a receptionist. This is still something we will do in the future, but until we do the Stage Plan Update, we will be letting you assign a receptionist from the start.

Just like the original, the receptionist will be tasked with assigning workers to clients while you're not around. Unlike the original, you'll be able to dictate the receptionist's priorities. You'll be able to have the receptionist focus on gaining money, reputation, brothel security, worker happiness, or experience points. This will hopefully reduce the amount of work it takes to manage the brothel and staff.

[h1][u][b]Outro[/b][/u][/h1]
That's about it for now. We have more things we want to add to this update, but we would rather finish everything above and see if we have time left before promising anything.

We want to know your thoughts in the comments and in our discord. What are you most excited about? Do you have any suggestions for Traits? Were you expecting something else in this update? Let us know.

As always, thank you for your support. We've grown a lot in the past week and we're ecstatic. We can't thank you enough for your support, kind reviews, and feedback. Thank you.
